name: QuickBooks AI / Intuit Assist
pricing_tiers: QuickBooks Simple Start: $15/month. QuickBooks Essentials: $30/month. QuickBooks Plus: $45/month. QuickBooks Advanced: $100/month. QuickBooks Solopreneur: $10/month. Intuit Assist: included in all QuickBooks Online plans at no extra cost. QuickBooks Payroll: $22.50/month + $5/employee. QuickBooks Live (AI + human bookkeeper): starting $50/month.
free_tier_available: yes — 30-day free trial; QuickBooks Solopreneur has very low entry price ($10/month); no permanent free tier
latest_major_release: Intuit Assist AI enhancements 2025-2026: AI-powered receipt capture/categorization, cash flow forecasting, automated invoice generation, AI-driven tax deduction identification, virtual AI bookkeeping agents (announced 2026); QuickBooks Online continuously updated monthly
key_capabilities: automated transaction categorization, receipt capture+data extraction (OCR + AI), AI invoice generation and payment reminders, cash flow forecasting/predictions, AI tax deduction identification, automated bank reconciliation, expense tracking with AI pattern detection, mileage tracking, payroll automation, QuickBooks Live (AI-assisted human bookkeeping)
integrations: native Intuit ecosystem (TurboTax, Mailchimp, Credit Karma); 750+ third-party apps via QuickBooks App Store; Shopify, PayPal, Stripe, Square, Amazon, eBay; major bank feeds (20,000+ financial institutions); Gusto, TSheets, Expensify; open API
smb_onboarding_time: hours (guided setup wizard; AI auto-categorizes transactions from first sync; bank connection setup 5-10 minutes)
mobile_support: QuickBooks mobile app (iOS/Android) — full accounting features including AI receipt capture via phone camera, invoice creation, expense tracking, mileage tracking
estimated_smb_users: 7 million+ QuickBooks Online subscribers globally (2025); dominant SMB accounting platform — 80%+ market share in US small business accounting; 30 million+ total QuickBooks users across all versions
market_differentiator: largest SMB accounting platform by far (80%+ US market share); AI embedded into core accounting workflows with zero learning curve; integrated tax prep (TurboTax); unmatched bank/receipt data ecosystem; Intuit Assist predicts cash flow 90 days ahead
key_competitors: Xero AI, FreshBooks AI, Wave Accounting, Sage Intacct, Zoho Books Zia
typical_roi_claim: Intuit claims QuickBooks AI saves 40+ hours/month on bookkeeping for average SMB; automated categorization reduces manual entries by 80%; cash flow forecasting helps 70% of SMBs avoid cash shortfalls
smb_adoption_trend: growing — Intuit Assist and AI features driving upgrades from desktop to online; 82% SMB AI adoption (SBE Council); QuickBooks AI features becoming table-stakes for SMB accounting
notable_smb_case_studies: Small construction company reduced month-end close from 5 days to 1 day with QuickBooks AI; freelance designer uses AI receipt capture to save 5+ hrs/month; retail SMB uses cash flow forecasting to optimize inventory purchasing
funding_to_date: Intuit: $16B+ annual revenue (FY2025); market cap $180B+; spending $1B+ annually on AI/data platform; no external funding (public company since 1993)
partner_ecosystem: QuickBooks ProAdvisor program (600,000+ certified accountants/bookkeepers); 750+ App Store apps; bank partner network (20,000+ institutions); Intuit Partner Platform for developers
community_support: QuickBooks Community (forums, millions of users), QuickBooks Tutorials/Help Center, QuickBooks Training (live and recorded), ProAdvisor certification program, annual QuickBooks Connect conference
